biggest_gap: Return loop: the failed sitting restarts with no visible reason to come back tomorrow, and the garden the player returns to still shows letter-coded mounds a non-reader cannot use.

Wrong-answer card frame: drop the dim orange so it reads as a retry, not an error.
Make the first watering visible in under 10 seconds, e.g. show a drop animation on the first tap.
Replace the AGAIN label with an icon plus a short sound cue for non-readers.
Carry the failed sitting's sprout into the garden so the pot visibly grows on retry.
